name: File Registry + Signed Uploads
summary: A SQL index of Object Storage: presigned uploads, pending→ready finalize, quotas, and joinable file metadata.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
env.description: S3-compatible Object Storage endpoint. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Object Storage access key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Object Storage secret key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: REGISTRY_PREFIX
env.description: Key prefix indexed. Tenant isolation is enforced against this prefix.

env.name: REGISTRY_UPLOAD_TTL_SECONDS
env.description: Lifetime of a presigned PUT URL. Short by default: a leaked long-lived URL is an open write grant.

env.name: REGISTRY_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
env.description: Largest upload the registry will issue a URL for, recorded so the finalizer can reject oversized objects.

env.name: REGISTRY_ABANDON_AFTER_MINUTES
env.description: A pending upload with no matching object after this long is marked abandoned.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Strongly recommended.

triggers.description: Flip a pending upload to ready, recording real size, content type, and etag from a HEAD.
Required by §5. Detects uploads the trigger missed, marks deletions (there are no delete events), and expires abandoned uploads.

operations.title: POST /uploads
operations.description: issue a presigned PUT and a pending row

operations.title: POST /finalize
operations.description: storage trigger — flip pending to ready with observed metadata

operations.title: POST /reconcile
operations.description: cron — missed finalizes, deletions, abandoned uploads
